title: Stamp 1: The Vichy Regime
welcome_lead: Stamp the dark Vichy years onto your historical passport.
meta_desc: A-Level French adventure on the Vichy regime, Petain, and Nazi collaboration 1940-44.
final_note: Vichy stamp logged. You understand l'Etat francais.

concepts.def: Collaborationist French government 1940-44, headquartered in Vichy.
WWI hero who became head of l'Etat francais and collaborated with Nazi Germany.
Signed 22 June 1940, ending fighting and dividing France into occupied and free zones.
Southern unoccupied zone administered by Vichy until November 1942.
Vichy's authoritarian programme: Travail, Famille, Patrie (Work, Family, Fatherland).
Vichy paramilitary force created 1943, hunting Resistance members and Jews.

walkthroughs.body_html: After Germany's swift invasion in May-June 1940, Petain signed an armistice. France was divided: the north and west occupied by Germany; the south administered from Vichy by Petain.
Vichy's Revolution nationale replaced 'Liberte, Egalite, Fraternite' with 'Travail, Famille, Patrie'. It passed anti-Jewish laws (Statut des Juifs, October 1940) without German pressure.
After the Allies landed in North Africa (Nov 1942), Germany occupied the southern zone too. Vichy lost what remained of its independence and increasingly relied on the Milice.
